activationBlockers.reason: Real production data must not be accepted until DB/Auth recovery has been rehearsed in an isolated environment.
Original Storage objects need an independent copy and a verified restore path before destructive-loss scenarios are acceptable.
Production activation needs a minimal owner-visible escalation and incident receipt beyond a GitHub monitor failure.
The hosting provider/service must be explicitly selected before inactive infrastructure is provisioned.

watches.reason: Not an activation blocker for a named single-owner pilot while current Beta performance budgets remain satisfied; required before broader rollout.
Enable when the Supabase plan permits; current password recovery and authentication gates remain active.
Required for maturity claims beyond the controlled pilot, not for provisioning an inactive isolated environment.
Remain disabled until export and recovery evidence is sufficient.

nextGate.purpose: Select the production hosting provider and define an inactive provisioning plan without activation or real user data.
